svg.title: .git folder structure
svg.desc: Structural diagram of the .git directory showing HEAD, config, index, objects, refs, hooks, and logs

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What exactly is inside the .git/HEAD file and what is detached HEAD state?')
sendPrompt('What is the .git/index file and how does it relate to the staging area?')
sendPrompt('What is inside .git/refs/heads/ and how do branches work as files?')
g.text: one file per branch → commit SHA

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do git tags work as files in .git/refs/tags/?')
sendPrompt('What are remote-tracking branches and how are they stored in .git/refs/remotes/?')
sendPrompt('How are git object files named and stored inside .git/objects/ subdirectories?')
sendPrompt('What are pack files in .git/objects/pack/ and why does git use them?')

g.text: history of where refs have pointed

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the .git/logs/HEAD file record and how is it useful?')
sendPrompt('What are git hooks and what scripts can I put in .git/hooks/?')
sendPrompt('What are ORIG_HEAD and MERGE_HEAD files in .git/ used for?')
sendPrompt('What is .git/packed-refs and when does git create it?')
